groups.saying_opens: ثم عرج بي حتى ظهرت لمستوى

notes: Two taḥwīl branches carry the Abu Dhar saying (Ibn Shihab and Anas are written as in the text, not merged). Both branches repeat the names, so the tail is null and each group writes Anas and Abu Dhar.

Two further isnads sit inside the matn: «وأخبرني ابن حزم أن ابن عباس وأبا حبة» (saying 2) and «قال ابن حزم وأنس بن مالك» (saying 3); each has its own transmitters and is stored as its own saying (rule 4a). Reading them as separate sayings is the less certain part.
«هو ابن أبي أيوب»-type glosses: none. The «أنس» surfaces are the first occurrence in the text.
